title: Low pressure and mixing
note: Approved narration (tools/videos/DESIGN.md). Drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code); approved by AlanziM2. Editing a recorded script costs ElevenLabs credits.

sentences.say: Pressure changes how fast gases mix.
sentences.show: Pressure changes how fast gases mix.

sentences.say: At lower pressure, gas molecules are further apart, so they collide less often and spread out faster.
sentences.show: At lower pressure, gas molecules are further apart, so they collide less often and spread out faster.

sentences.say: Halve the pressure, and gases spread about twice as fast.
sentences.show: Halve the pressure, and gases spread about twice as fast.

sentences.say: On Earth, rising hot air does most of the mixing, so this barely matters.
sentences.show: On Earth, rising hot air does most of the mixing, so this barely matters.

sentences.say: In microgravity, spreading is the only way oxygen reaches a flame, so it matters a great deal.
sentences.show: In microgravity, spreading is the only way oxygen reaches a flame, so it matters a great deal.

sentences.say: At low pressure, oxygen arrives from further away. The flame grows larger, and dimmer.
sentences.show: At low pressure, oxygen arrives from further away. The flame grows larger, and dimmer.

sentences.say: A Moon Base would run at about 10.2 pounds per square inch, well below the space station's 14.7.
sentences.show: A Moon Base would run at about 10.2 psi, well below the space station's 14.7.

sentences.say: So the evidence that counts comes from tests at the right pressure, not only the right oxygen percent.
sentences.show: So the evidence that counts comes from tests at the right pressure, not only the right oxygen percent.

sentences.say: NASA's database holds 33 microgravity tests in the Moon Base range.
sentences.show: NASA's database holds 33 microgravity tests in the Moon Base range.

sentences.say: All of them burned fuel droplets. None tested a gas flame or a cabin material in that atmosphere.
sentences.show: All of them burned fuel droplets. None tested a gas flame or a cabin material in that atmosphere.
